svg.text: LIVE: How tokens and token IDs are generated
Animated, loops every 28 seconds · open in a browser
You type a question. The model cannot read letters, so it has to be converted.
Split into single characters (really bytes) → 34 pieces.
Merge round 1: frequent pairs join: W+h→Wh, a+t→at, h+e→he, s+h→sh …
Merge round 2: keep merging: Wh+at→What, ␣t+he→␣the, de+sh→desh …
No more merge rules apply → 8 tokens. (␣ = leading space is part of the token)
Each token is looked up in the fixed vocabulary table → its integer ID.
The model reads all IDs → scores every vocab entry → picks one → appends it → repeats.
The model picks the special <end> token → generation stops.
CONTEXT SENT TO THE MODEL (token IDs)
What is the capital of Bangladesh?
Token splits, IDs and probabilities are illustrative. Every model family has its own tokenizer and vocabulary.
